description: This file defines a data structure interface for agent entities and a function that creates table column definitions for displaying agent data in a React table component. It includes rendering logic for various columns such as agent name, description, version, capabilities, skills, I/O modes, public status, and a details button.

methods.name: agentHubColumns
methods.description: Generates column definitions for a React table component to display agent data, enabling custom rendering for each column and interactive features like copy-to-clipboard and modal dialogs.
